images.original_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration of T-AXU-007 坐位上躯干侧屈活动. Reference images 1, 2, 3 strictly define the SAME adult East Asian woman. Preserve her recognizable face, black ponytail, natural healthy slim body and normal adult limb and torso proportions; exactly the same fitted white short-sleeve T-shirt and dark charcoal full-length trousers. Photorealism and soft studio lighting must match references.
Scene/backdrop: exactly same light cool gray-blue seamless studio background and floor as reference pictures. Only a plain stable gray four-legged chair, no wheels, and plain white sports shoes.
Pose: front-facing woman seated securely on the chair, both feet flat on floor, both knees about 90 degrees, BOTH SIT BONES and both buttocks remain planted on seat. Show gentle lateral bend of upper trunk toward her LEFT (viewer right), about 10–15 degrees. Chest faces front, no trunk rotation, no pelvis shifting sideways and no raised buttock. Her left hand slides a little down her left thigh and rests there. Her right upper arm is softly raised outward and upward with elbow comfortably bent; right fingertips rest LIGHTLY BESIDE her right temple/ear, not behind head and not pushing or pulling the head. The raised arm serves only as an optional light lever. Face calm, gaze forward, head naturally follows trunk, shoulders relaxed. Clear modest side-bend arc in upper trunk, not merely tilting head. Her spine and chest curve softly laterally while pelvis remains level.
Composition: direct FRONT full-body view, vertical 4:5 portrait photograph, entire head/ponytail, both hands including raised elbow, chair and both complete shoes within frame with margins. Single person, single exercise phase, anatomically correct normal proportions, no limb duplication, no distortion, no text, numbering, labels, captions, arrows, split panels, collage or watermark. Preserve same woman and exact reference clothing/background/photo style.
